speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One and forty, and four and forty and six, and fourteen and six. A hundred shillings. Five pound, if you are strict. He called it near.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen and six is the whittawer's, and it is the same fourteen and six. She wrote that it need not trouble me. It has troubled the ticket.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing paid. A shop-ticket is a sum. It is not a warrant.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A fortnight. The horse is still a sentence in her letter. Enough.
